verdict.rationale: Anthropic's own developer docs include an explicit Limitations section for vision. It names concrete failure modes: hallucination on low-quality, rotated, or very small images; approximate spatial coordinates; imprecise counting; and inability to detect AI-generated images. That is the vendor stating in its own docs what the model is bad at. missing for 10: evidence of limitations documentation beyond vision (e.g., coding, reasoning, long-context, or tool-use failure modes), a consolidated model-level known-weaknesses page, independent corroboration of how candid these docs are

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents the model's failure modes and jagged edges — what it is bad at, in its own docs, not just what it aces

citations.quote: Accuracy: Claude might hallucinate or make mistakes when interpreting low-quality, rotated, or very small images under 200 pixels.
Counting: Claude can give approximate counts of objects in an image but might not always be precisely accurate
AI-generated images: Claude cannot determine whether an image is AI-generated and might be incorrect if asked.
